title: getrusage accepts a NULL output pointer without copyout error
mechanism: sys_getrusage wraps the whole result construction and copyout in `if rusage_addr != 0` and returns 0 otherwise, so a NULL output pointer reports success instead of EFAULT.
contract: getrusage(2): EFAULT is returned when usage points outside the accessible address space, and Linux returns EFAULT for a NULL usage pointer.
observed: By source reading at the pin (not run): getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, NULL) returns 0.

repro.how_to_run: Run `make static` in repro/ on x86-64 Linux, copy bin/abi_probe into an Asterinas guest, and run `abi_probe <case>` for rusage_null. repro/README.md gives the saved Linux output.

caveats: SOURCE LEAD, Asterinas NOT_RUN. Output-pointer validation only, separate from AST-60 accounting. Invalid `who` values still fail with EINVAL before this check. Legacy text-only probe.
